headline: Approved three budget transfers and sent three Waltham High School schedule questions to administration for answers.
summary: The meeting covered school improvement plans for Northeast Elementary, Whittemore, and the dual language school. Public speakers raised the secretaries' contract and a new executive position. The $290,874.39 request for more money for the 617 Lexington Street project will return on a future agenda.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including October 21 meeting minutes and donations.
Approved getting the Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and religious holiday survey data by the next meeting, with a calendar vote then.
Approved sending three Waltham High School schedule questions to administration for public answers.
Tabled the item on school committee subcommittee meetings.
Approved three budget transfers dated November 4.
Approved paying the bills on warrant.
discussion: Secretaries contract: Public speakers said school secretaries have gone 491 days without a contract and asked for a fair offer.
Executive position: A speaker questioned the new communications role with a salary of $140,000 to $160,000, approved October 21, and a $3.3 million operating deficit.
High school schedule: A parent asked for schedule options, data, and a timeline before the November 23 forum, and asked the committee to put three questions to administration.
617 Lexington Street: Members asked about PCB contamination cleanup, temporary power, and why the cost rose about $300,000 over the original $825,000 allocation.
School calendar survey: Members discussed the survey results on Labor Day, Thanksgiving, and religious holidays, including possible effects on staffing and student learning.

decision_evidence.quote: Any questions on the consent agenda? I'll entertain a motion. Move approval. Second. All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed? The ayes have it.

I motion that we get to see the data by the next school committee meeting and have a deciding vote then about our calendar. ... Second. Any questions? All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed, the ayes have it.
I respectfully request that the three questions that have been asked tonight be forwarded to Dr. Kanad so he may answer them. ... All in favor? Aye. Any opposed? Yes, have it.
Motion to table since Ms. Mitchell was not here. Motion to table. All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed, the ayes have it.
Motion to approve transfers. Second. Any questions? All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed? The ayes have it.
Motion to pay the bills. Second. Any questions on the bills? All those in favor? Aye. All those opposed? The ayes have it.
